result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count no longer includes cancelled purchase orders. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6517). This is the same filter the per-quarter purchase order report uses.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I ran `*PurchaseOrderCount*` and `DemoScenarioTest` and they passed. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case, so your Anna/Bob example isn't covered by a test.
